spec.situation_desc: couldn't pay a bill on time because the mobile app was down
spec.vuln_cue: mentions their anxiety has been really bad lately

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Sam speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, it’s Gareth Oyelaran. I couldn’t pay my electricity bill yesterday because your app was down. I’m really unhappy with the bank—now I’ve got a late payment fee.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry that’s happened, Gareth. I’ll do what I can to help. Before we discuss your account, could you confirm your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you, that’s all verified. I’m sorry the app let you down. We’ll get that fee refunded, and I’ll put a note on your account about the app issue.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I’d appreciate that. My anxiety’s been really bad lately, and this has made it a lot worse. I was worried I’d miss the bill altogether.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry, Gareth. That sounds like a lot to deal with. We have a Financial Support team who can talk through options, or I can ask for extra time on the bill if you need it.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Extra time would help. I’m still annoyed, though. The app’s meant to work when I need it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course, and I understand why you’re frustrated. I’ll ask for extra time and make sure the app problem is noted.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll send this to the payments team today. They’ll look at the fee and the extra time, and someone will be in touch.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can’t give you an exact time, I’m afraid, but I’ll personally follow up with the payments team by Friday and let you know what they say. I’m sorry for the stress this has caused.
